reviewer: Codex: five-language first-use website material, native execution and rendered output review
review_scope: Read the complete five-language outlines, fictional studio profiles and hours updates. Reviewed all 20 exact demonstration/practice pages for Vera and Lucia through actual full-page desktop and phone browser captures, with observed navigation, widths and console state. The browser returned JPEG bytes: their original bytes were preserved and filenames corrected, and the current workflow now accepts PNG or JPEG evidence with matching headers, dimensions and hashes. Each reviewed run has a real recorded quality assessment and valid quality_ready state. Fresh native preparation/implementation/mechanical checks in website-teaching-release-04 reproduce every reviewed site digest after that repair. Those tests use explicitly authored fictional briefs and HTML, not simulated browser acceptance. This accepts prepared local teaching material; it does not attest a professional publication decision, human lesson timing/comprehension or live native voice and paired-window learner interaction.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The plain title teaches making a first informational website from studio material. The learner chooses a supplied profile, requests an introduction/activities/contact page, finds the real local output and checks it on computer and phone. The website itself is the lesson outcome; the hours update is a small practice task after the complete first-use sequence.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Read vera-studio-it.md and vera-update-it.md. The fictional Studio Arco profile supplies the small-Italian-business audience, bookkeeping and tax-return preparation, the reserved reception email and Monday–Thursday 09:00–12:00. The Friday 14:00–16:00 update expressly preserves the original facts. Missing real identity, registrations, address and notices are not invented. Sources explicitly select only a local teaching website.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The current native workflow initializes a private workspace, snapshots selected source bytes, records an explicitly authored source-bound brief and validates the actual HTML/CSS and bundled fonts. Design uses the mapped brief. The learner first identifies the visitor and contact location, then follows actual implementation and opens the contact section at phone width. All 20 pages were reviewed in a browser at 1280 and 390 pixels, with full-page captures, Enter navigation to the contact anchor, no horizontal overflow and no reported console warnings/errors. The recorded assessment binds that evidence to unchanged current site and validation hashes.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: Reviewed the it working page, source/design summary and final card with descriptive links to editable files, both browser views and current validation. The page clearly presents bookkeeping and tax-return preparation, the supplied contact and exact hours with a restrained readable design. Local quality review is complete; the next learner action is to locate and compare those facts. No professional acceptance, preview package, release package, hosted URL or publication is represented as completed.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: The second native run adds Friday 14:00–16:00 and preserves Monday–Thursday, services and email. Regression checks preserve every predecessor file byte. The practice handoff links its own preceding version and the changed page. Both changed layouts were actually reviewed. The repeat instruction explains how to supply public-facing firm material, choose first-site versus refresh, review the result and only then select an authorized publication destination.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Read the complete it outline, mapped profile/update, rendered content and localized human handoffs.
